parsed.explanation: The XML contained several Unicode escape sequences that needed to be converted to their proper characters, and one unescaped ampersand. The fixes are: 1) \u221a\u00fc (√ü) → \u00e4 (ä) in 'Augustinergäu'; 2) \u221a\u2202 (√∂) → \u00f6 (ö) in 'Völcker-Historie'; 3) \u221a\u2020 (√†) → \u00a7 (§) before 'Cattenburg'; 4) '&' → '&' in 'Vita & Scriptis'; 5) \u221a\u2264 (√≤) → \u00b0 (°) in '8°.'; 6) \u221a\u2202 (√∂) → \u00f6 (ö) in 'Bödickers'; 7) \u221a\u00a7 (√ß) → \u00e4 (ä) in 'Grundsätze'; 8) \u221a\u2264 (√≤) → \u00b0 (°) in '8v°.'; 9) \u221a\u2264 (√≤) → \u00b0 (°) in '8v°.'. Additionally, a missing closing </BIBL> tag was added after the 'Sapientia Mos.' entry to properly close the BIBL element that contained the FORMAT tag.
